newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ registered unemployment falls again in March.
newsitem.headline: NZ registered unemployment falls again in March.

text.p: The number of New Zealanders registered as unemployed fell to 152,711 in March from 158,217 in February and 164,147 in January, the Employment Service said on Thursday.
The number of people on the register reflects those who have chosen, as one of their methods of looking for work, to enrol with the service and who are available for employment.
The official measure of unemployment is the Household Labour Force Survey, which showed the jobless rate at 5.9 percent in the December 1996 quarter.
